summary: Application shell components, Context Providers, and React Flow views used within the Next.js App Router.
context_hints: ProjectEditor.tsx composes the workspace shell; feature business logic belongs under src/features
Contains the 'Nodes' implementation for React Flow
GlobalAssetsClient uses the shared personal Global Asset transport; restore first reads the trashed entry and submits its deleteOperationId as the Host CAS input

subdirectories.nodes: Custom React Flow node components (e.g., VideoNode, TextNode). The visual representation of data.
subdirectories.copilot: Components for the Chatbot/AI Assistant sidebar interface.

key_files.AppPage.tsx: Shared authenticated content-page inset, semantic narrow/standard/wide width contract, AppPageHeader title/description/action rhythm, and AppBreadcrumb hierarchy navigation; full-bleed editors remain outside it.
key_files.BrandAsset.tsx: Registry-backed renderer for Clash-owned identity, feature, and state artwork. Consumers select a semantic asset name instead of repeating public paths.
key_files.AppFeedback.tsx: The single transient feedback queue and toast viewport. Errors persist until dismissed; warning/info/success timing and reduced-motion behavior are centralized here, and activity events adapt into this provider instead of rendering another viewport.
key_files.ProjectEditor.tsx: The primary workspace component integrating React Flow and the Toolbar. Project Asset membership comes from Project Loro; resolved Host projections refresh on each membership revision and retry the same revision after transient Host disconnects.
key_files.BrowserSurface.tsx: Backchat-derived Electron webview surface with navigation, persistent page state, and element/region annotations routed into the shared Agent annotation contract.
key_files.ProjectBrowserSurfaces.tsx: Keeps every Project sidebar browser tab mounted while exposing only the selected webview surface.
key_files.DashboardComposerContext.tsx: Route-stable Dashboard draft and Project/Skill reference state, including the shared drag-and-drop boundary and focus handoff.
key_files.DashboardComposerDock.tsx: Persistent Home/Marketplace bottom Composer dock with an external compact searchable Project scope tag, in-surface Skill references, shared Backchat runtime controls, and one same-document transition into Project.
key_files.ProjectCard.tsx: Project-browser card that loads one Host-derived Main canvas WebP per revision and keeps the lightweight geometry SVG as a no-media loading/error fallback.
key_files.MarketplacePluginDetail.tsx: Canonical Marketplace plugin detail surface with shared breadcrumb navigation and registry-declared metadata, inputs, outputs, and required capabilities.
key_files.marketplaceRouting.ts: Single canonical path builder for action and skill detail links used by Marketplace cards and the Home featured feed.
key_files.desktopShellLayers.ts: Semantic desktop shell elevation order shared by Dashboard task surfaces and transient sidebar preview layers.
key_files.copilot/AgentAnnotationBlock.tsx: Special composer block for editable agent-addressable review notes from Canvas, Timeline, and Director Stage.
key_files.copilot/AgentAnnotationContextMenu.tsx: Shared context-menu action that sends an addressable workspace object into the composer.
Captures native text selections inside creative surfaces, renders numbered anchored highlights, and queues an optional comment through the shared agent annotation contract.
key_files.LoroSyncContext.tsx: React Context provider for the Loro CRDT sync engine.
key_files.CanvasViewContext.tsx: Navigation context for generator-free Canvas View nodes that open their referenced draft Canvas.
key_files.nodes/CanvasViewNode.tsx: View-only Canvas plugin card; it opens a referenced Canvas and intentionally exposes no Generator action or output handle.
key_files.VideoEditorContext.tsx: State management for the video editing timeline.
key_files.GlobalAssetsClient.tsx: Personal Global library UI over the shared import, trash, and observed-operation restore lifecycle.

architecture_notes: Keep ProjectEditor focused on workspace composition. Asset Preview/Edit, thumbnails, media resolution, and action clients belong in src/features/assets; shared action semantics belong in @clash/shared-types/actions. Home and in-session Composer surfaces reuse the same Backchat-derived editor, model/permission controls, send/voice state, and content-driven resize logic; Clash extends that core only through capability-scoped Project/Canvas/Timeline context and density tokens. Authenticated content pages must use AppPage/AppPageInset instead of page-local outer padding; Settings applies it inside its scroll pane, while Project/editor workspaces remain full bleed.
